_doc: Per-indicator FETCH specs for the Pressure layer — what scripts/fetch-pressure-observations.mjs pulls to compute each indicator's window % change. Mirrors data/cost-index-sources.json: every spec carries `verified`. EIA/USDM/NWS specs are VERIFIED (stable series id / keyless REST). The NASS Quick Stats and AMS specs are best-guess query skeletons (verified:false) — confirm the exact short_desc / report slug against the live discovery endpoint, flip verified:true, then go live. Keys (free): EIA_KEY, NASS_KEY. USDM + NWS are keyless. scripts/check-pressure-sources.mjs validates shape + manifest alignment and reports readiness.

diesel.note: Weekly U.S. No. 2 diesel retail (EIA Open Data v2). VERIFIED series id.

drought-ca-az.note: US Drought Monitor REST, CA+AZ state FIPS, severe-area share. Keyless.

freeze-alert.note: Active freeze warnings over the winter growing zones (api.weather.gov). Keyless; encodes active=+1.

feed-futures._verify: Confirm CBOT corn+soy settlement field in an AMS daily grain report (e.g. ams_3046 Minneapolis) or My Market News; window 4w (~20 business days).

ams-shipments._verify: Confirm the Fruit & Vegetable Movement report slug + per-commodity shipment-volume field on My Market News (MARS v1.2).

broiler-placements._verify: Confirm the exact short_desc for weekly broiler chicks placed (Broiler Hatchery) in the NASS Quick Stats param browser.

cattle-on-feed-placements._verify: Confirm monthly Cattle on Feed placements short_desc.

hogs-market-supply._verify: Confirm quarterly Hogs & Pigs market-hog inventory short_desc (weight-class total).

cold-storage-poultry._verify: Confirm monthly Cold Storage poultry stocks short_desc.

cold-storage-beef._verify: Confirm monthly Cold Storage boneless-beef stocks short_desc.

cold-storage-pork._verify: Confirm monthly Cold Storage pork stocks short_desc.

crop-condition._verify: Confirm weekly Crop Progress condition (% good/excellent) short_desc per crop (potato/onion).
